subject: GDPR: DPA & SCC module selection — follow-up from discovery call
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Green <olivia.green@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: GDPR: DPA & SCC module selection — follow-up from discovery call

Hi Olivia — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and next steps from today's discovery: 

- Redwood overview: hosted inference with options for Dedicated and Private deployments; we covered data handling, encryption in transit/at rest, and audit logging.
- Main asks from your side: preferred DPA language, which SCC module to use for EU transfers, and confirmation of controller/processor responsibilities (you mentioned AcmeHealth is controller for patient data).
- Action items we committed to: share our DPA draft, SCC mapping matrix, and SOC 2 status; kick off the vendor security questionnaire.

To move this along, can you confirm: 
1) AcmeHealth's role (controller or processor) for the data we’ll handle? (I believe controller)
2) Whether you intend to rely on SCC Module Two (Controller-to-Processor) for data transfers?
3) Procurement timeline/target for a signed DPA?

I've looped in Marissa (security & legal lead) to share the DPA draft and SCC mapping. We'll also ask Neha from the product/security team to own the questionnaire.

Next steps proposed:
- Marissa to share draft DPA + SCC matrix (today)
- Acme to confirm controller role and preferred SCC module (by EOD Wed)
- Kickoff call to complete vendor questionnaire (schedule next week)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the attachments and proposed times.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

From: Olivia Green <olivia.green@acmehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Lead <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GDPR: DPA & SCC module selection — follow-up from discovery call

Thanks Rishi — good meeting. Confirming the following: 

- AcmeHealth is the data controller for patient/PHI. Redwood would be acting as a processor for the services you provide.
- For cross-border transfers, our legal team usually asks vendors to accept SCC Module Two (Controller-to-Processor).
- Procurement timeline: we need a completed DPA and vendor questionnaire within ~2 weeks to hit our Q2 project start; procurement lead (cc'd) will manage the contract steps.

I've attached our vendor security questionnaire and DPO contact details. Please let me know if Redwood can accept Module Two and if you can share a draft DPA today so procurement can start review.

Olivia Green
Head of Security & Privacy | AcmeHealth
olivia.green@acmehealth.com

(Attachment: AcmeHealth_Vendor_Sec_Questionnaire_2027.pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GDPR: DPA & SCC module selection — follow-up from discovery call

Hi Olivia — thanks for confirming. Quick reply from the legal/security side: 

- Redwood acknowledges AcmeHealth as Controller and Redwood as Processor for the described use cases. We are comfortable with SCC Module Two (Controller-to-Processor) for EU data transfers; we've mapped the specific clauses in the attached SCC_mapping_acme.xlsx.
- Attached is our current DPA draft (Redwood_DPA_draft_v2.pdf). It's a standard processor DPA with processor obligations, subprocessor notice, and data export mechanisms. Please flag any redlines your team needs.
- SOC 2: we are currently completing a SOC 2 Type II assessment. The report is expected by end of Q2 2027 — I can share the report and any SOC 2 bridging letter as soon as it's finalized.
- We can start the vendor security questionnaire now. Neha will own the technical/ops questions; I’ll handle the legal/security responses.

Proposed next steps:
1) Acme to review the attached DPA and SCC matrix and send any redlines by next Wed (2027-03-10).
2) Redwood (Marissa/Neha) to start answering the vendor questionnaire — propose a 30–45 minute kickoff on Tue 2027-03-08 at 10:00 AM PT (or an alternative time).
3) Rishi to track procurement/deal milestones (deal ID ACME-2027-045).

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_draft_v2.pdf, SCC_mapping_acme.xlsx

Thanks — happy to jump on a call if helpful.

Best,
